verdict.rationale: Kong publishes a Konnect AI Gateway v1 API reference with operation summaries such as list-ai-gateways, so a structured API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. The OpenAPI probe at generic paths returned 404, which says nothing about the reference's interactivity either way. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
